adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, the code loops usernames and calls `group.add(user)` without checking whether the user is already in the group (`usernames.split(",").each ... group.add(user)`). The new controller spec for `.add_members` only tests adding two distinct users and does not cover adding an existing member, so this edge-case is untested. Whether it actually raises/500s depends on how `Group#add`/the join model handles duplicates (not shown in the diff), so the asserted 500 is not verifiable from the diff alone.
